_doc: Numerical bar the cuda_combat_arbiter must clear to be presentable as a drop-in replacement for the AgentChess production arbiter. Each gate has measurable target(s); run_validation.py computes pass/fail per gate. Tier 1 = rule correctness, Tier 2 = adds daemon protocol, Tier 3 = adds live wall-clock parity. Smoke and full are sample-size profiles.

G1_replay_parity.description: Both referees agree on legality + same terminal kind for every move on a sample of arbiter-produced PGN games.

G3_bench_coalescer.description: BatchCoalescer in-process: parity vs serial, ≥1.5x FFI speedup at N=8 concurrency, no deadlock at N=16.

G4_daemon_smoke.description: Batched daemon completes one real fighter game over its socket without errors.

G5_daemon_concurrent.description: Batched daemon serves N concurrent games over its socket without errors or hangs.

G6_live_wall_ratio.description: Live-mode end-to-end wall-clock ratio (arbiter / cuda) over identical fighter pairs at concurrency=1, lifted caps. Caps wide because fighters are non-deterministic; we only check the cuda referee is not dramatically slower or faster.
